dog.description_text:
Glimmer aka Sammi

Short Bio: Sammi is a sweet, playful lovebug who adores people, kids, and other dogs! This smart, food-motivated puppy is fully house-trained, sleeps through the night (preferably snuggled next to you!), and loves puzzle toys, cuddles, and learning new tricks. She's a happy, social pup who greets everyone with enthusiasm on walks and would thrive with an active family that enjoys both playtime and cuddle time.

Personality & Characteristics: Sammi is a fully house trained velcro dog who loves being near her people when home. She's incredibly social, playful, and affectionate. Very smart and food-motivated, making training a joy! She's curious about the world and excited to explore everything on walks.

My foster dog is good with: ✓ Dogs (loves playing with other dogs and would prefer a home with another dog!) ✓ Kids ✓ People (she's super social!)

My foster dog is: ✓ House trained ✓ Crate trained (can stay crated 3-5 hours with long-lasting bones)

3 Keywords for your pup: Playful, Affectionate, Social

Energy Level: 7 (energetic and playful but also loves cuddle time)

Barker? Or Quiet Pup?: Quiet - jumps for attention when needs to potty. Only barks when door rings

Walking Manners: She's excited about the world and wants to say hi to everyone. She sniffs everything and explores enthusiastically. Working on leash manners as she can get excited. However does great on leash & rarely pulls when there are no distractions!

Appetite: Healthy appetite - eats twice daily (morning and evening)

Favorite Things:

- Playing with sticks and balls

- Fetch games

- Puzzle toys

- Cuddles and sleeping in bed with her people

- Playing with other dogs

- Meeting new people and dogs on walks

Commands/Tricks: ✓ Sit ✓ Paw ✓ Lay down ✓ Come ✓ Fetch/bring toys back

Additional Notes:

- Goes potty twice daily (morning and evening walks)

- Sleeps through the night

- Can be left alone with enrichment toys

- Previous foster had her for 7 months
